name: Dominant-Axis Triangle Voxelization
definition: A triangle rasterization algorithm that determines which voxels in a sparse voxel DAG are intersected by a triangle. It selects a dominant axis based on the triangle normal to optimize projection tests and column casting.
summary: Dominant-Axis Triangle Voxelization projects triangles onto 2D planes aligned with their dominant normal axis to optimize sparse voxel intersection testing.
